test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some windows are houses.

Some windows are roofs.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some roofs are houses.

II. Some roofs are windows.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Explanation:

The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca6e1c89bf6f3435811251b5315c3c32f931da996ebd74d267185d2da97a81a1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some roofs are houses. → Does not follow (because some windows are houses and some windows are roofs, so we cannot say that some roofs are definitely houses.)

II. Some roofs are windows. → Follows (because some windows are houses and some windows are roofs, hence some roofs are definitely windows.) 

Hence, “Only conclusion II follows”.
